definitions.explanation: Describes a claim or expression that overstates the truth, making something seem greater or better than it really is. Carries a critical, negative tone.

examples.japanese: {誇大|こだい}な⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{誇大|こだい}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That advertisement was criticized as exaggerated.

examples.japanese: {誇大|こだい}な⟦{宣伝|せんでん}→宣伝：03307_senden⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{惑|まど}わされて→惑わす：28047_madowasu⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧しまった。
examples.english: Misled by exaggerated advertising, I ended up buying an expensive product.

notes:
Used as a na-adjective ({誇大|こだい}な) and in fixed compounds. Always carries a critical nuance of overstatement.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {誇大|こだい}⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧: false/misleading advertising
- {誇大|こだい}⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧: exaggerated expression
- {誇大|こだい}{妄想|もうそう}: delusions of grandeur; megalomania

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大|おお}げさ→大げさ：19918_oogesa⟧: exaggerated — everyday and conversational
- {過大|かだい}: excessive; overestimated — emphasizes "too much" rather than boastful overstatement
